name: A Chance Encounter with a Trickster
source:
You're going home one day after a horrible week at work when one day, a man in a weird outfit accosts you and starts demanding your money! What the hell is going on?

You're a tired minimum wage middle-aged adult just living their life when you encounter Trickster Coyote, a man in costume trying to be a dressed-up criminal in a world where comic book heroes and supervillains just aren't the norm! You might get out of this encounter unscathed but your mental state might not be.

[From [url=https://fioxis.itch.io/a-chance-encounter-with-a-trickster]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在经历了可怕的一周工作后的某一天，你正要回家，有一天，一个穿着奇怪衣服的男人向你搭讪，并开始向你索要钱！到底是怎么回事？

你是一个疲惫不堪的拿着最低工资的中年人，刚刚过着自己的生活，这时你遇到了骗子郊狼，一个穿着戏服的男人，试图在一个漫画英雄和超级恶棍并不常见的世界里成为一名盛装罪犯！你可能会毫发无伤地摆脱这次遭遇，但你的精神状态可能不会。

[来自[url=https://fioxis.itch.io/a-chance-encounter-with-a-trickster]Itch.io[/url]]
